acceptanceCriteria: A recorded divergence decision, then a machine-readable closure-depth member in impact output or its capability listing, with parity manifest updated and tests.
body: Residual from V1-2044 (PR #1316, AFP-V0-094..096). One-hop depth and 'READY is not a closed test selection' are stated only in help and docs/CAPABILITIES.md because impact bytes are pinned by conformance/cli-parity-v0/manifest.json (CCF-V1-006). Expected: impact receipts or the `impact --capabilities` listing (V1-2047) state the closure depth machine-readably. Needs a divergence decision.
title: impact receipts carry no machine-readable reverse-import closure depth or not-a-closed-selection marker
